ticket: The supplier payment file has not reached the bank. It should have gone across at 20:00 and the bank confirm nothing has landed. Payment run has to be acknowledged by 07:00 or the whole run slips a day and we breach terms with about 200 suppliers. The file is in the outbound folder, timestamped 20:00, so it generated fine.

result.reasoning: Payroll-equivalent dated deadline (07:00 cutoff) with 200 suppliers at risk of term breach; file generated but not delivered is a transfer failure blocking a critical business process.
result.root_cause_direction: Check the outbound integration job logs and API/SFTP credentials to the bank; verify the transfer attempt succeeded or failed, and whether authentication or connectivity is the blocker.
result.draft_reply: We see the file generated at 20:00 but did not reach the bank. We need to check the transfer job logs immediately to see whether the send attempt failed and why. Can you provide: (1) the exact filename and size of the file in the outbound folder, (2) whether your bank credential or API key for this payment file transfer has been rotated or renewed recently, and (3) access to the integration job logs covering 20:00–21:30 last night. If the transfer failed due to credential expiry or rotation (similar to INC-1003), we may need to refresh those with the bank and retry. We're treating this as blocking and will prioritize the log review now.
